wsjHeadlines.title: NYSE Is Getting Trounced in the Battle for Wall Street’s Biggest IPOs
wsjHeadlines.description: Anthropic is expected to bring the Nasdaq another blockbuster listing, following SpaceX. And the Texas Stock Exchange is also emerging as a threat.

wsjHeadlines.title: How to Play the Retreat in Defense Stocks
wsjHeadlines.description: Smaller defense companies have fared worse recently, presenting a possible buying opportunity.

wsjHeadlines.description: The problem may be bigger than a few weak brands. Pepsi needs to stop tinkering and consider more fundamental changes.

wsjHeadlines.description: AI agents inserting themselves between businesses and customers pose challenges for e-commerce players caught in the middle.

wsjHeadlines.title: Rising Rates Threaten Wall Street’s Golden Goose in Trading
wsjHeadlines.description: Weak bond markets undermine what had been a strength for big banks.

wsjHeadlines.description: Weak earnings coupled with a fine has analysts pressing executives about whether there is more pain to come.

wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks rose as strong earnings from Elon Musk’s SpaceX eased concerns about the profitability of the artificial-intelligence business, sparking gains for chip makers.

wsjHeadlines.title: French Bond Yields Hit Multiyear Highs, U.S. Treasury Yields Edge Higher
wsjHeadlines.description: Yields on eurozone government bonds rose while the French 10-year bond yield hit its highest level since July 2002 as inflation, budget and debt risks lingered on both sides of the Atlantic.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Rise as SpaceX Earnings Boost AI Trade
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks rose, with the Nasdaq leading gains, after SpaceX’s earnings gave a big boost to the artificial-intelligence trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: NYSE Just Extended Options Trading Hours. It’s Only the Beginning.
wsjHeadlines.description: The New York Stock Exchange said plans to open up options trading for roughly two hours before the market’s typical 9:30 a.m. ET opening bell and then again for 15 minutes after the 4 p.m. ET closing bell.

wsjHeadlines.title: Musk Ordered Starlink Slowdown That Crippled Ukraine’s Drones and Sowed Panic in Kyiv
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, autism-therapy workers say big chains pressured them to boost treatment hours, and NYSE is getting trounced in the battle for Wall Street’s biggest IPOs.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Stock Indexes Mixed as Oil Holds Above $110
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes were mixed in muted early trade as elevated oil prices weighed on sentiment.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Stocks Mixed as AI Spending Concerns Linger
wsjHeadlines.description: Asian equities were mixed after rebounding on improved risk sentiment, as concerns about aggressive artificial-intelligence spending continued to linger.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Don’t Punish the Productive
wsjHeadlines.description: Growing the pie year after year is what built our standard of living and our civilization.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Elon Musk Beats Anthropic on Giveaways
wsjHeadlines.description: He says he’ll give every child a share of SpaceX, aka a stake in capitalism.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | For Investors and Savers, TINA Is Giving Way to TARA
wsjHeadlines.description: Rising Treasury yields mean stocks will become less attractive, interest-bearing accounts more so.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | To Give Investors Certainty, Reform Permitting
wsjHeadlines.description: America needs new sources of capital, but it also needs a more predictable path to building projects.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Market’s Rude Reminder on AI
wsjHeadlines.description: Sooner or later investors will demand returns, and there will be losers.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The End of the Libor Fraud Persecution
wsjHeadlines.description: A flagrant attempt to scapegoat bankers for the last crisis collapses.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Fall on Mild Near-Term Weather Outlook
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures extended their slide to four sessions with mild near-term weather forecasts keeping demand expectations at bay.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Settles Mixed as Shipping Risks Temper Optimism About Flows
wsjHeadlines.description: Crude oil futures ended the session mixed with December WTI falling in its debut as front month, and Brent settling practically unchanged.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Inch Higher on Oil Price Retreat
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold settled 0.2% higher, snapping a two-session losing streak, while silver fell 0.5%, down two of the past three sessions.

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on gold prices, BlueScope Steel and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Crude Oil Stockpiles Fall More Than Expected
wsjHeadlines.description: Commercial crude oil stocks decreased by 3.1 million barrels last week. Analysts had expected crude stocks to be down by 300,000 barrels.

wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar edged higher and is seen possibly weakening slightly in the near term on AI fears.

wsjHeadlines.title: WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.25% to 96.96
wsjHeadlines.description: The WSJ Dollar Index fell 0.3% — down three of the past four trading days.
